title: Taint parent containers on unresolvable selector values, never drop silently
context: The scanner was silently dropping entries when it couldn't interpret them (block-scalar headers, nested maps, etc.), which made selector/labels maps more permissive than intended — a partial map matches more workloads than the user specified, creating false-positive references and universal-match risks. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: When a value in a selector/labels map is malformed or unresolvable, taint the entire parent container (return null) instead of silently omitting the entry. Apply this rule to: block-scalar headers (taint parent, skip the line), nested maps (detect descendants and taint), __proto__ keys (safe construction via Object.fromEntries), and bare list markers (explicit frame handling to preserve context).
consequences: Resources with block-scalar names/references are now correctly unidentifiable instead of falsely colliding on the header token (e.g., '|-')
Invalid k8s structures (nested maps in selectors) are detected and rejected, not silently dropped
__proto__ keys are stored as real own properties, never swallowed into the prototype
References nested under bare list markers are now extracted instead of reparented/dropped
The scanner fails safely (returns null) rather than returning permissive partial matches that over-select workloads
alternatives_rejected: Returning partial maps with unresolved entries dropped — too permissive, causes false-positive matches
Skipping __proto__ guard as 'unreachable via valid k8s' — blast radius (matches every workload) warranted the one-line hardening
Using Object.create(null) for __proto__ safety — broke existing test suite's plain-object equality checks
Treating bare list markers as unrecognized lines — lost the sequence frame, reparenting children one level up
